ex.en: Don't click on that link.
ex.zh: 不要點選那個連結。

ex.en: Here are some interesting links.
ex.zh: 這裡有些有趣的連結。

ex.en: Please do not answer this fraudulent e-mail and certainly do not click on the links in the e-mail.
ex.zh: 請不要回覆這封詐騙郵件，更不要點擊信中的連結。

ex.en: There is a link between smoking and cancer.
ex.zh: 抽菸和癌症之間有關聯。

ex.en: Police are looking for links between the two crimes.
ex.zh: 警方正在尋找兩起犯罪之間的關聯。

ex.en: Our hearts are linked.
ex.zh: 我們心意相通。

ex.en: The tunnel links the two cities.
ex.zh: 這條隧道連接兩座城市。

ex.en: The living room in my new house is very large.
ex.zh: 我新家的客廳很大。

ex.en: The living room furniture was modern in style.
ex.zh: 客廳的家具是現代風格。

ex.en: The living room is adjacent to the dining room.
ex.zh: 客廳緊鄰著餐廳。

ex.en: I found the apartment through an online listing.
ex.zh: 我是在網路上的物件資訊找到這間公寓的。

ex.en: Check the TV listings for tonight's programs.
ex.zh: 看一下今晚的電視節目表。

ex.en: The bank faced a liquidity crisis.
ex.zh: 那家銀行面臨流動性危機。

ex.en: Cash gives a company more liquidity.
ex.zh: 現金讓公司擁有更高的流動性。

ex.en: Take the red line to the city center.
ex.zh: 搭紅線到市中心。

ex.en: This subway line runs every five minutes.
ex.zh: 這條捷運線每五分鐘一班。

ex.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
ex.zh: 這兩條線成直角相交。

ex.en: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
ex.zh: 地圖上的紅線代表鐵路。

ex.en: I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我朋友現在正在電話上。

ex.en: Please hold the line.
ex.zh: 請不要掛斷。

ex.en: There was a long line outside the bakery.
ex.zh: 麵包店外面大排長龍。

ex.en: Please wait in line.
ex.zh: 請排隊等候。

ex.en: I'll liaise with the client about the delivery date.
ex.zh: 我會和客戶聯絡協調交貨日期。

ex.en: She liaises between the sales and design teams.
ex.zh: 她負責業務和設計團隊之間的聯絡協調。
